Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE1 is the edit target. Trace this ONE complete original game-animation drawing exactly in its existing position on the 1536x1024 canvas. Make only the edges smoothly antialiased instead of pixel stair steps, and remove the plain gray backdrop to real transparency. Keep ALL painted shapes opaque and keep all empty gaps truly transparent. Same EXACT silhouette, proportions, position, color per surface and size. Keep the broad source margins. The reference is low-resolution; its raster stair steps are NOT the design. Replace every stepped edge by its intended CLEAN STRAIGHT LINE or clean continuous curve. This applies to the heart, colored internal boundaries and every orange/maroon piece. The output must be a clean HD illustration, never pixel art or a softened nearest-neighbor enlargement. Preserve every small separate piece and its position. Do not reinterpret them as 3D low-poly objects, add facets, change angles, move pieces, enlarge details, add shading/highlights or complete a normal body. NO GLOW, gradients, lighting, bloom, shadows, texture or outlines.

Meaning and phase: ONE flattened/unfolded virtual dragon source low across the canvas, with a small red hovering puzzle heart above. Preserve the exact two large pointed end shapes and the scattered maroon/orange crest triangles floating above them. The rightmost pointed orange/maroon end has ONE very small NARROW black facial mark near its lower-left fork, shaped like a short irregular slit; do not enlarge it into a triangular opening, and do not add extra eyes. Preserve the tiny orange shard at far LEFT below the large flattened end, and the little orange dot beside its lower points. At right retain the exact thin pink remnant grip and the tiny pale-yellow detached slanted tip. The middle orange/maroon low body and bent foot-like strips keep their exact large gaps, overlaps and relative positions. No normal body, head or neck reconstruction and no broad sword. Flat source colors, clean HD angled edges with no pixel stair steps anywhere.

This is an intentionally unusual FLAT virtual-reality animation from Sam & Max Hit the Road. The RED GAME HEART is a stylized flat puzzle token that becomes a key, not anatomy. Trace its exact red/dark-red areas and its top notch. IMAGE2 is approved normal Sam identity/color support only, but this source contains NO SAM and no new Sam must be introduced. IMAGE3 is actual game context ONLY, never the target. Do not copy scenery, the separate ground sword or other actors. Draw only the ONE complete source in image1 and preserve every tiny source piece and gap. No new parts, particles, text, frame or watermark. Exactly one 1536x1024 transparent PNG with the one complete drawing in precisely its image1 position.
